Horned or shaggy animal character loose among a Border side's dancers

Country of the Seeonee hills, home ground for these tales
Chattering branch-swinger of the thieving Bandar-log
Morning and afternoon job of getting pupils to lessons, often by hired bus
Kind of horse worn rather than ridden, its jaws snapping at the crowd
Short white trousers buckled at the knee, standard kit for many sides
Glassed-in nook at the front of a bus, holding the wheel and the pedals
